packageRules.description: Modules sonic-mgmt-common's patches/apply.sh patches in vendor/ here, and openconfig/gnmi, whose newer versions require newer goyang and ygot. A bump has to refresh the patch, so it opens on its own, and only on dashboard approval. A security update still opens, on its own (see vulnerabilityAlerts above, which repeats this list), and the patched-module label keeps the preset from labeling it automerge.
prBodyNotes: sonic-mgmt-common's `patches/apply.sh` patches this module in `vendor/` here, or, for `openconfig/gnmi`, the goyang and ygot it requires. A patch that still applies may no longer be correct for the new version, so check each one against it. This update is never labeled `automerge`.
